title: Zesty Smoky Dutch Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, garlicky Dutch lamb stew with a smoky flavor, perfect for a crowd, featuring lamb shanks and dairy-free friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shanks with salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shanks until browned on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the carrots, potatoes, vegetable broth, and tomato paste to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the lamb shanks to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falling off the bone.
Remove the pot from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.
